mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates above 5.0% signal economic weakness and reduced corporate profit expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to deteriorating labor market conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) indicate an accommodative monetary policy stance amid rising prices, which typically triggers negative equity returns as investors anticipate inflation-driven rate hikes and economic instability over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250 and FEDFUNDS < 1.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle characterized by elevated federal funds rates above 3.0%, the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a resilient economic outlook and controlled inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust manufacturing activity and corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing market conditions (HOUST < 1000) reflect declining consumer demand for major purchases, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity and potential recessionary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales growth (RSAFS > 470000) signals strong consumer spending and economic vitality, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market discounts sustained demand-driven corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 470000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates contraction in manufacturing output and supply chain stress, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profitability and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100 over a 3-year rolling window.
